name: Freelance software tester, paid hourly (Testlio)
summary: Managed crowdtesting company that pays vetted freelance testers by the hour for client test runs, with occasional Canada-specific projects.
whatYouDo: Once registered and accepted onto client projects, you run scripted or exploratory test 'runs' on apps and websites, report issues and log your time. Canada-specific projects have included smoke-testing a wagering app in Alberta and payment testing.
appeal: Paid by the hour, not per bug
Weekly payouts via PayPal or Payoneer
Open to people without prior testing experience; certifications available
watchOuts: A Testlio page says only about 3% of applicants are accepted onto client projects
The Canada-specific postings we found were closed
Some projects need specific devices (e.g. iPhone/iPad), a non-CAD credit card, or physical presence in one province
ID verification needed before payment; contractor terms with no benefits

training.notes: Optional certifications (e.g. Functional Regression Testing) unlock the Testlio community; cost not stated, assumed none.

compensation.notes: Mirrors of Testlio Canada postings: US$30/hr Alberta app smoke testing (about 30–60 min every few weeks); US$18/hr plus bonuses for a Canadian delivery-driver study. Both appear closed.

reliability.notes: Project-based; one Canada project offered under an hour every few weeks; selective acceptance (~3%).

applicationSteps: Register a Testlio account and verify contact details
Complete your profile and devices; optionally earn certifications
Apply to specific projects (Canada postings name a project code for email applications)
Complete ID verification and add a personal PayPal/Payoneer account before working
fitsIf: You own current devices, want hourly (not per-bug) testing work, and can wait for selective project placement.
notFitIf: You need work soon or lack the specific devices projects require.
